name: command
title: Command palette
description: A dialog that is one search field over a list of commands.
use: A shortcut to every command of an application, opened from anywhere with a key such as ⌘K and searched by typing. It is a dialog with a different interior: write class="dialog command". Every command in it must be reachable some other way too.

instead.when: The list fills a form field with one value
It is a short list of actions that belongs to one button
The modal holds a question or a form, not a search over commands

keyboard.action: With the behavior: open the palette from anywhere, or close it when it is open
With the behavior: hide the options that do not match and make the first match the active one
With the behavior: move the active option, skipping disabled ones and wrapping at the ends
With the behavior: move to the first or the last option
With the behavior: run the active command and close the palette
Close the palette and return focus to where it was, as the native dialog does

platform.fallback: A button opens the palette without script where they are supported; elsewhere call dialog.showModal() from a click handler
A click on the scrim does nothing; Escape still closes the palette

classes.name: command
classes.description: Beside dialog, on the same dialog element: the palette's interior without padding, 36rem wide, placed near the top of the viewport so the field stays where it is while the list changes length

classes.name: command-search
classes.description: The field row, on a label so the whole row focuses the input. It holds an icon, the command-input and an optional hint

classes.name: command-input
classes.description: The bare search input, with role="combobox" and aria-controls pointing at the list. It has no material of its own: the dialog is its surface

classes.name: command-list
classes.description: On the listbox of results: it takes the remaining height and scrolls inside the dialog

classes.name: command-footer
classes.description: A row of key hints under the list

classes.name: command-hint
classes.description: One hint in the footer: keys, then what they do
